events.title: Library: Audiobook Walking Club
events.location: Buena Vista Branch Library (300 N. Buena Vista St.)
events.description:
All ages and abilities welcome—walk, run, stroll, or roll at your own pace. Enjoy fresh air, a great audiobook, and some movement all at once!

Last Thursday of the Month | 9:30am – 10:30am
Meet in Lincoln Park behind Buena Vista Branch Library

We'll start with a brief check-in to share what you're listening to and swap recommendations. Then, head out for a walk, run, stroller stroll, or wheelchair roll while listening to stories on your device. Prefer chatting instead of listening? That’s fine too—silence isn’t required.

Bring any audiobook you love, whether it’s the latest bestseller on Libby, Hoopla, or Palace Project, or a beloved classic. Library staff will be available to help with audiobook apps.

This all-ages, drop-in program is a fun, flexible way to enjoy stories and get moving. Invite your whole family! Intergenerational groups are welcome (kids can listen to their favorites while adults enjoy theirs).

Our goal is simple: to carve out an easy, welcoming space for books, wellness, and each other.

And if you haven't picked up a physical book in a while, no worries—you still don't have to. 😉 Let’s Listen & Move!

No registration required (though appreciated).

events.description:

events.title: Library: Vardavar in the Park
events.location: *New Location: Northwest Branch Library (3323 W. Victory Blvd.)*
events.description:
Come celebrate Vardavar with Burbank Public Library! Եկեք տոնենք Վարդավառը Բըրբենքի հանրային գրադարանի հետ։

Join us in the park behind Northwest Branch Library for our Vardavar celebration! We'll have music by the Burbank Music Academy, crafts for kids and adults, and food! 

There will be a designated splash hour from 1 - 2 PM where you can throw water balloons, run through our misters, or splash around in the designated baby-zone.

Please remember to wear a bathing suit and/or clothes you're comfortable getting wet and bring a towel! For everyone’s safety and enjoyment, please do not bring your own water toys, like water guns or Super Soakers. All water play items will be provided at the event.

You won't want to miss this celebration in the park!
 

Միացե՛ք մեզ Հյուսիսարևմտյան մասնաճյուղի գրադարանի հետևի այգում՝ մեր Վարդավառի տոնակատարությանը մասնակցելու համար։ Մենք կունենանք Բըրբենքի երաժշտական ​​ակադեմիայի երաժշտությունը, ձեռագործ աշխատանքներ երեխաների և մեծահասակների համար, ինչպես նաև ուտելիք։

Ժամը 13:00-ից 14:00-ը կլինի հատուկ ջրցողման ժամ, որի ընթացքում կարող եք ջրային փուչիկներ նետել, վազել մեր ջրցանների միջով կամ ջրցողել նախատեսված մանկական գոտում։

Խնդրում ենք հիշել, որ պետք է հագնել լողազգեստ և/կամ հագուստ, որը ձեզ հարմարավետ կզգա թրջվելու դեպքում, և ձեզ հետ վերցնել սրբիչ։ Բոլորի անվտանգության և զվարճանքի համար խնդրում ենք ձեզ հետ չբերել ձեր սեփական ջրային խաղալիքները, ինչպիսիք են ջրային ատրճանակները կամ Super Soaker-ները։ Բոլոր ջրային խաղերի պարագաները կտրամադրվեն միջոցառման ժամանակ։

Դուք չեք ցանկանա բաց թողնել այս տոնակատարությունը այգում։

events.title: Library: The 5 Pillars of Retirement
events.location: Buena Vista Branch Library (300 N. Buena Vista St.)
events.description:
Market swings. Changing tax laws. Questions about long-term care, income, and legacy planning. If you’re wondering how all of this affects your retirement, you’re not alone. You’ve worked hard to build what you have. Now it’s time to make sure it’s protected, positioned, and working efficiently for you.

Join us for an educational workshop, presented by EnJoy Financial, covering Risk mitigation, stress-free income, tax planning, long-term care and legacy planning (including how to deal with the current market environment).

Get professional guidance on potentially reducing the taxation of your retirement income (including your estate), and how to position yourself for better returns with the current market situation. You'll also learn about different investment types for retirement.

Attend This Workshop And Learn:

  • How to reduce or eliminate retirement taxes
  • Financial strategies that could increase your retirement income and last a lifetime
  • Find out if you need a will or a trust
  • How to structure your retirement savings so you never have to worry about running out of money
  • Common misconceptions about retirement and estate planning
  • Tools and methods available to retirees to help develop a retirement tax strategy

events.title: Adult 55+ Fiesta Hermosa Day Trip
events.location: Hermosa Beach
events.description:
The Labor Day Fiesta Hermosa event, originally named “Fiesta de las Artes” continues its long-standing tradition of celebrating artisan culture. For more than a decade, Fiesta Hermosa has been known as Southern California’s largest beachside arts and crafts festival.  This Labor Day weekend event features a massive arts and crafts fair with over 250 vendors! You’ll enjoy live music by your favorite artists on four stages, while experiencing local and global flavors like street tacos, steaming oysters, delicious empanadas, Italian gelato, classic kettle corn, and many more tasty dishes available at the Food Fair. There is also a beer & wine garden (for an additional $10 pre-paid charge) where you can have local beer, wine, and cocktails while listening to great music with festive, friendly people.

The whole Fiesta Hermosa event promises to be an unforgettable vibrant beach experience you won’t want to miss!

This Day Trip has a "Walk Grade" of MODERATE to HARD (4 out of 5)

events.title: Library: Into the Darkness - John Carpenter's Cathedral
events.location: Buena Vista Branch Library (300 N. Buena Vista St.)
events.description:
Join us for a special conversation with Sandy King and Sean Sobczak, co-authors of the highly anticipated graphic novel John Carpenter's Cathedral, releasing this August on Storm King Comics alongside a companion heavy metal album of the same name via Sacred Bones Records.
 
Inspired by a vivid nightmare that filmmaker and horror legend John Carpenter could not shake, Cathedral plunges readers into a hallucinatory world of dread lurking beneath Los Angeles. The story follows a chilling chain of murders connected to an abandoned church, unfolding as a dark and cinematic vision that spans both page and sound.
 
Moderating the discussion is award-winning horror author, editor, and bookseller Del Howison, co-founder of the legendary Dark Delicacies bookstore. A longtime champion of the horror genre, Howison will guide the conversation as King and Sobczak discuss transforming Carpenter's unforgettable nightmare into a graphic novel, from developing its haunting world and unforgettable characters to crafting suspense through the unique language of comics.
 
Whether you're a fan of horror, graphic novels, music, or John Carpenter's iconic work, this event offers a rare opportunity to hear from the creators behind one of the year's most anticipated graphic novels and gain an inside look at the creative process that brought this terrifying vision to life.

Copies of John Carpenter's Cathedral will be available for sale at a discounted price and the co-creators will sign copies after the program.

events.title: Library: Free Shakespeare in the Park
events.location: Buena Vista Branch Library (300 N. Buena Vista St.)
events.description:
The Actors' Gang brings pop culture, familiar characters, music, and dance to Shakespeare in the Park for Families!

For over 18 years, The Actors' Gang has performed their Free Shakespeare in the Park for Families show in Culver City's Media Park. For the first time, they are thrilled to bring their production to Burbank Public Library and Lincoln Park! Their 50 minute adaptation of William Shakespeare's play Two Gentlemen of Verona will bring...love, laughter, and invaluable life lessons to anyone who attends. The play will include pop culture references, familiar characters, music, dance, and of course Shakespeare's poetry.

Performances will take place on Saturday, August 29 and Sunday, August 30 at 12:00 noon.

Bring a blanket to sit on, sun protection, snacks, and water!

events.title: Adult 55+ Festival of Arts Pageant of the Masters Day Trip
events.location: Laguna Beach
events.description:
Spend an evening at the Festival of Arts in Laguna Beach’s Irvine Bowl and be amazed and en-chanted by ninety minutes (including a 15-minute intermission) of living pictures, incredibly faithful recreations of classical and contemporary works of art. This masterful production will take you on an unforgettable journey through the works of Michelangelo, Picasso, Monet, Van Gogh, Velázquez, Norman Rockwell and more. Masterpieces won’t just hang on walls—they’ll come alive in a breath-taking blend of art, music, and theatrical wonder!

In addition to the Pageant of the Masters, your ticket gives you summer-long access to over 100 Orange County artists displaying their paintings, photography, sculpture, jewelry, and more. There are also daily live concerts that can be heard throughout the Irvine Bowl grounds while you dine at various dining establishments.

So come experience the award-winning Pageant of the Masters. The best presentation of its kind and arguably one of the most unique productions in the entire world!

*Price includes transportation, ticket entry, and summer-long access to the Festival of Arts grounds.

This Day Trip has a "Walk Grade" of MODERATE (3 out of 5)

events.description:
Social media isn't just about sharing pictures anymore; it is a highly engineered environment designed to capture and hold our attention. In this empowering session, we step behind the screen to decode exactly how social media feeds, infinite scrolls, and engagement loops operate. You will learn how to help your children, and yourself, recognize algorithmic traps and develop the cognitive resilience needed to step away. Leave with the insider playbook to shift your family from passive digital consumers to active digital owners who navigate the online world with intention and confidence.

events.title: Burbank Water and Power Board Meeting
events.description:
BWP's Board meetings are typically held on the first Thursday of each month at 5:00 p.m. at the BWP Administration Building, third floor Boardroom, 164 W. Magnolia Blvd., Burbank, California. 

This facility is disabled accessible. Auxiliary aids and services are available for individuals with speech, hearing or visual impairments (48 hours notice is required). Please contact BWP at (818) 238-3550 to make arrangements. 

Full agenda packets and meeting minutes are available on the Burbank City website at Burbankca.gov.

events.title: Civil Service Board
events.location: City Hall Council Chambers
events.description: The powers and duties of the Board shall be: To hold hearings regarding rules to supplement this article and subsequent revisions and amendments thereto and to recommend to the City Manager for submission to the Council such rules as are herein provided for; To act in an advisory capacity to the City Manager and City Council on problems concerning personnel administration; As provided by this article and by any rules, adopted to supplement this article, to hear appeals submitted by any employee hereunder, relative to any situation connected with his employment status or condition of employment; and, In any hearing conducted by the Board, it shall have the power to examine witnesses under oath and compel their attendance and/or the production of evidence before it by subpoenas issued in the manner and subject to the penalties provided by law. Each member of the Board shall have the power to administer oaths to witnesses.

events.title: Burbank Athletic Federation Board Meeting
events.location:
Community Services Building, Room 101
150 N. Third St.
events.description:
Since 1947, The Burbank Athletic Federation (BAF) has assisted the Parks and Recreation Department with fostering, promoting, and developing amateur athletics in the City of Burbank.

The goals of the BAF include building good sportsmanship and character, citizen training, and physical maintenance for all participants as well as encourage friendly rivalry, group spirit, and team play. Meetings are held the first Tuesday of each month.
